study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the EPIC cohort
reason: The abstract reports incident prostate cancer overall but does not report an analysis of advanced, high-grade, metastatic, lethal, or otherwise aggressive incident disease.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: A high score on a factor reflecting a long-chain n-3 PUFA pattern was associated with greater risk of prostate cancer (OR for highest compared with lowest quintile: 1.36; 95% CI: 0.99, 1.86; P-trend = 0.041).
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported estimate concerns overall prostate cancer risk, with no aggressive endpoint stated.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
